title: Limit correction to whole-sheet translation
description: Constrain the initial correction model to finite whole-sheet horizontal and vertical translations in millimetres, with actual derived values still unavailable behind the unresolved physical-policy gate.
acceptanceCriteria: The correction value contains only translationXMillimetres and translationYMillimetres
Values must be finite millimetre quantities and serialize without implicit unit conversion
Scale, rotation, skew, warping, and per-label parameters are unrepresentable
No nonzero production correction can be constructed from demo, synthetic, prototype, or unresolved-policy input

steps.details: Add a versioned two-axis millimetre value with finite-number validation and explicit zero representation.
Keep scale, rotation, skew, warping, per-label offsets, and implicit matrices outside all correction and profile schemas.
Require a successful approved derivation result before constructing nonzero production translation; current calls return TASK-102 refusal.
Cover finite x/y serialization, invalid numbers/units, unsupported keys, zero software fixtures, and blocked nonzero construction.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; define the narrow value object and gate tests only.
BLOCKED: physically derived x/y values do not exist and must not be fabricated.
Zero test fixtures verify software behavior only and are not calibrated profiles.
